description: Create row/column guides on one page (like Layout > Create Guides, limited to this page)

fitMargins.description: Divide the area inside the margins (true) or the whole page (false)

guideColor.description: Guide color: UI color name (e.g. "BLUE", "GRID_GREEN") or "r,g,b" (0-255)

layerName.description: Layer to create the guides on (default: active layer)

numberOfColumns.description: Number of columns (2+ creates vertical guides)

numberOfRows.description: Number of rows (2+ creates horizontal guides)

removeExisting.description: Remove the page's existing guides first

name: create_page_guides
title: Create Page Guides
